### Known gaps

- InstanceCollection.MarketType is not emitted: the SDK documents it only as 'On-Demand or Spot' (types.go:1000) with no enum or example, so the wire strings are unverifiable.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- GetPredictiveScalingForecast honours StartTime/EndTime (hourly points, up to 30 days) but the series is a flat projection of the current DesiredCapacity -- no ML forecasting model exists in an emulator.
- PutScheduledUpdateGroupAction.Time is documented by the SDK as no longer used; nothing to model.
